description: The settings.get environment-shadow case (S44 T5, CS4): a process environment in force beats the stored row, so the EFFECTIVE value is the environment's with source="environment", but the stored row is NOT hidden — stored is the table's value and shadowedBy names the env var that overrides it ("your saved value is being overridden"). Three-state honesty: the app shows the environment value AND the shadowed row AND the name, rather than collapsing "the env won" into a bare value. A client that lists later may still see the shadow until the env clears.
